description: Add your own artifact to the company’s documents, made by you (agents read it as material, not instructions): exactly one of `markdown`, `html`, `media_ids`, `upload_id` or `type` + `content`. `use_as_context` (default true) lets the team read it. Nothing is spent. The result has `app_url`, its page in the web app: give the person that link.

company.description: the company id (list_companies); not needed when you have one company, asked for otherwise

html.description: a whole HTML page (up to 2 MB), titled from its <title>

markdown.description: markdown: `---`-separated slides become a deck, under 300 words a note, else a report

media_ids.description: finished Studio media: one video, or 1–12 images

type.description: an artifact type (with `content`), checked against its schema

upload_id.description: a finished file you uploaded (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, image, .md, .html, .csv)

name: create_artifact
title: Make an artifact
